name: SharePoint File Creation
description: Generate a requested file, enforce a safe pre-upload size gate, and upload it to SharePoint without streaming bytes through the model.
author: Lewis Baybutt
coverImageAlt: Sealed file passing through a measured transfer gate into an organized document repository.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a sealed blank file object passes through a carefully calibrated size gate and follows a protected transfer channel into an orderly document repository, expressing safe creation and upload without exposing its contents
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered slate transfer bay with a warm paper destination archive and ample negative space
Subject: one sealed file-shaped object, an unmarked physical measuring gate, a protected cyan transfer channel, and a neatly organized repository shelf
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at small card size
Lighting/mood: calm, secure, quietly technical, restrained cyan backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, interface labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; no Microsoft-style gradient
